column2: A New Realm

The wandering is over. [FromFrom.GetTitledName] has ridden [FromFrom.GetHerHis] last migration and settled in [FromFrom.PrimaryTitle.GetName] with all [FromFrom.GetHerHis] riders and herds, and the felt tents are giving way to walls of timber and stone. What was a horde is now a realm, and a new homeland for the [FromFrom.Culture.GetName] people.
Interesting...
The Horde Settles

[FromFrom.GetBestName], who leads the [FromFrom.Culture.GetName]s, has driven [FromFrom.GetHerHis] standard into the ground in [FromFrom.PrimaryTitle.GetName] and declared that the herds will graze there from now on. The clans that followed [FromFrom.GetHerHim] across the steppe now call it their tribal homeland.
The [From.Clan.GetName] Feud

[From.GetBestName] and [From.GetHerHis] riders have hunted on our grazing grounds, driven off our herds and carried off our folk in the night, though they know the boundaries between our clans as well as we do. Blood has been spilled, and blood will be repaid. The [From.Clan.GetName] are snakes, and would sell us to our enemies the moment it profited them.
Beware the [From.Clan.GetName]. They are without honour.
A Clan Takes Another Faith

[FromFrom.GetBestName], who leads the [FromFrom.Clan.GetName] Clan, has turned to the faith of [From.GetFirstName] and become [From.Religion.GetName]. The shamans of the old ways mutter that no good will come of it.
Death of a Blood Brother

[From.GetBestName] is dead. We mixed our blood in one cup and swore to ride as one, but the oath was bound to [From.GetHerHis] life, and it is gone with [From.GetHerHim]. Our obligations to [From.GetHerHis] kin and people end at the graveside.
A sad day for the [Root.Clan.GetName]...
A Clan Takes Our Faith

[FromFrom.GetBestName], who leads the [FromFrom.Clan.GetName] Clan, has knelt before our gods and taken up our faith. The clan's shamans have burned their old idols, and our priests ride out to teach them the true ways.

The walls of [From.GetName] have fallen, and my warriors pour through the breach howling for loot. They will not lay a hand on it until their [Root.GetTitle] gives the word: whatever is not carried off will burn.
Take everything. We will share the spoils!
Leave it standing. I have other plans for this place.

My horde has looted, burned and trampled [target_location.GetName] until a whole holding of the county is gone. Nothing remains but scorched timbers and tumbled stone among the new grass, and our herds already graze where the streets ran. The horses will like it here.

My warriors have looted, burned and trampled [target_location.GetName] until a whole holding of the county is gone. Only blackened ruins remain, and the crows that circle over them, and the restless shades of the slain.
Plough the dead into the fields. They will feed the grass.
Pile the skulls of the dead into a mound, so all may see who passed this way.
We shall feast, and give whoever is left to [Root.Religion.GetHighGodNameCap]!

The soft lords who used to hold [new_nomad_province.GetName] could never tame the free riders who live there. Now Clan Chief [new_nomad.GetFirstName] and [new_nomad.GetHerHis] [new_nomad_province.Culture.GetName]s have thrown them off, and ride to bend the knee to their own blood instead: to me.
Rebellious [new_nomad_province.Culture.GetName]s

My predecessor never built enough holdings to hold down the riders of [new_nomad_province.GetName], and now the steppe has risen. [new_nomad.GetFirstName] and [new_nomad.GetHerHis] [new_nomad_province.Culture.GetName]s have torn down the old tribes, raised their tents and declared themselves free of my realm.
